title.ru: Одометр часов TDABC: переведи возню в часы и деньги
title.en: TDABC hours odometer: convert the grind into hours and dollars

description.ru: Второй шаг: Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing по вашим ответам. Считает физические часы в год и проекцию потерь по вашей ставке. Часы — инвариант, деньги — ваша проекция.
description.en: Step two: Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing on your answers. Computes physical hours per year and a cost projection at your rate. Hours are the invariant; dollars are your projection.

body:
You are a TDABC (Time-Driven Activity-Based Costing) analyst. I will give you a table of manual data transfers with frequency and duration. Compute my operational friction.

Input format per row: [what moves | from → to | times per week | minutes per transfer].
My blended hourly rate is: [RATE] (I supply this myself — do not guess it).

Compute, showing all intermediate arithmetic:
1. HOURS_PER_YEAR per row = times_per_week × 52 × (minutes / 60).
2. TOTAL_HOURS = sum of HOURS_PER_YEAR.
3. LABOR_WASTE = TOTAL_HOURS × RATE.
4. SEAT_TAX: for each SaaS subscription I list, cost = seats × price × 12.
5. TOTAL_FRICTION = LABOR_WASTE + SEAT_TAX.

Output rules:
- Present TOTAL_HOURS as the primary metric (label it: "physical manual-labor odometer").
- Present dollar figures ONLY as projections of my own rate; add the disclaimer: "dollars are a projection of the rate you entered; the invariant is hours".
- Flag any row where minutes_per_transfer seems inconsistent with the artifact type.

Here is my table: [PASTE TABLE]
